summary: Frontend-only UI regression of the redesigned /live-signals page (new analyzing loader, no 'Live signal ready' heading, redesigned result card + direction hero, static clock face with rotating hands). Tested on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 375x800 with the provided Firebase test user. All 6 review-request checks pass on both viewports.

desktop_1920.instruction_strip: Place the CALL at 00:34 · 1 Step MTG must if it loses

critical_code_review_comments: Only DOWN direction was not exercised in this run (server returned UP on both attempts). The CSS class sig-hero-down and PUT chip styling remain unverified in-runtime, though the code branch is symmetric to the UP path and static analysis of live-signals-view.tsx shows both branches are wired to the same testids and structure.

Minor: The analyzing stage timer is hard-coded to exactly 10s in a setTimeout. If the /api/signals/live POST is slow, the analyzing stage still runs the full 10s AFTER the response returns, so total wait can exceed 10s. Not a bug per spec but worth documenting in code comments.
